council tax - update address. also redirect post b4 moving day

moving out sat 8th. van 9am. keys back to agent the day after. clean oven before

Abigail - dinner @ hers sun 7pm. bring dessert, no nuts (her son)

viewing 2 - Walthamstow 1 bed, 4 Nov 2026. nice but no outside space. 2nd viewing poss the wk after

Fang - invited me to her parents' 40th anniv party in Leeds, 22 Nov. not sure I can make it, tell her by fri

Alejandro - his landlord's selling, has to be out by 31 Jan 2027. looking in Hackney + Dalston but rents have gone mad, everything 2 bed is 2.4k+. v worried, Beatriz might have to move back to Madrid if they can't find somewhere. viewing on the 14th, then a 2nd one the next morning. send him the Zoopla link tonight
Mila's housewarming tonight - she's nervous no one'll come. go early, help set up. text Ellie to come too
Kofi's daughter Esi - graduating Leeds uni July 2027. Kofi + Barbara both going up
Beatriz - fine after the breakup apparently. new flat in Brixton. starting pottery classes
Amy's dinner party - went well!! she was so worried. Yaw + Kasia got on. Amy hinted she wants Kasia's lasagne recipe, ask Kasia
Michael Khan - my old manager. moved to Sheffield, works for the uni now. married, 2 boys
leaving London 2 November 2026 - train 10am, Mum picking me up @ York. sort broadband the day before + cancel gym after

Yosef - packing up the flat, says Hana's been brilliant. leaving do @ the pub thurs 6 Nov. Hana's sister flying in that morning to help w/ the kids. I'm bringing the card. ask him how the drive went the day after, + check how they're settling a wk later
